name: Bushiroad Inc.
summary: Bushiroad Inc. engages in the entertainment business in Japan, the United States, Asia, and internationally. It is also involved in the planning, development, production, and sale of trading card and digital games; planning, creation, and production of comics and anime programs; the planning and production of music content and pro-wrestling events; and the operation of a voice actor office, as well as merchandising and advertising agency businesses. In addition, the company provides Bushiroad Main IP and TCG products, including CardFight!!
